tasks.label: 🔐 Check API Credentials
tasks.command: cmd_region='${input:region}'; cmd_user='${input:apiUser}'; if [ -n "$cmd_user" ]; then xml_api_cli api_check --region "$cmd_region" -u "$cmd_user"; else xml_api_cli api_check --region "$cmd_region"; fi

tasks.label: 🧰 List Applications
tasks.command: cmd_region='${input:region}'; cmd_type='${input:apiType}'; if [ -n "$cmd_type" ]; then xml_api_cli app_list --region "$cmd_region" -t "$cmd_type"; else xml_api_cli app_list --region "$cmd_region"; fi

tasks.label: 🧾 Application Info
tasks.command: cmd_id='${input:appId}'; cmd_name='${input:appName}'; cmd_region='${input:region}'; cmd_type='${input:apiType}'; if [ "$cmd_type" = 'REST' ]; then xml_api_cli app_info --app_name "$cmd_name" --region "$cmd_region" -t "$cmd_type"; else if [ -n "$cmd_id" ]; then xml_api_cli app_info --app_id "$cmd_id" --region "$cmd_region" -t "$cmd_type"; else xml_api_cli app_info --app_name "$cmd_name" --region "$cmd_region" -t "$cmd_type"; fi; fi

tasks.label: 📜 Build List
tasks.command: cmd_id='${input:appId}'; cmd_name='${input:appName}'; cmd_region='${input:region}'; if [ -n "$cmd_id" ]; then xml_api_cli build_list --app_id "$cmd_id" --region "$cmd_region"; else xml_api_cli build_list --app_name "$cmd_name" --region "$cmd_region"; fi

tasks.label: 🧩 Build Info
tasks.command: cmd_id='${input:appId}'; cmd_name='${input:appName}'; cmd_region='${input:region}'; cmd_build=''; cmd_scan=''; if [ -n '${input:buildId}' ]; then cmd_build="-b ${input:buildId}"; fi; if [ -n '${input:scanType}' ]; then cmd_scan="-s${input:scanType}"; fi; if [ -n "$cmd_id" ]; then xml_api_cli build_info --app_id "$cmd_id" ${cmd_build:+$cmd_build} ${cmd_scan:+$cmd_scan} --region "$cmd_region"; else xml_api_cli build_info --app_name "$cmd_name" ${cmd_build:+$cmd_build} ${cmd_scan:+$cmd_scan} --region "$cmd_region"; fi

tasks.label: 🧮 Detailed Report
tasks.command: cmd_id='${input:appId}'; cmd_name='${input:appName}'; cmd_format='${input:format}'; cmd_scan=''; cmd_region=''; cmd_prefix=''; cmd_out=''; if [ -n '${input:scanType}' ]; then cmd_scan="-s${input:scanType}"; fi; if [ -n '${input:region}' ]; then cmd_region="-r${input:region}"; fi; if [ -n '${input:prefix}' ]; then cmd_prefix="-p${input:prefix}"; fi; if [ -n '${input:outDir}' ]; then cmd_out="-o${input:outDir}"; fi; if [ -n "$cmd_id" ]; then xml_api_cli detailed_report --app_id "$cmd_id" -f"$cmd_format" $cmd_scan $cmd_region $cmd_prefix $cmd_out; else xml_api_cli detailed_report --app_name "$cmd_name" -f"$cmd_format" $cmd_scan $cmd_region $cmd_prefix $cmd_out; fi

tasks.label: 💬 Summary Report
tasks.command: cmd_id='${input:appId}'; cmd_name='${input:appName}'; cmd_format='${input:format}'; cmd_build=''; cmd_scan=''; cmd_region=''; cmd_prefix=''; cmd_out=''; if [ -n '${input:scanType}' ]; then cmd_scan="-s${input:scanType}"; fi; if [ -n '${input:region}' ]; then cmd_region="-r${input:region}"; fi; if [ -n '${input:prefix}' ]; then cmd_prefix="-p${input:prefix}"; fi; if [ -n '${input:outDir}' ]; then cmd_out="-o${input:outDir}"; fi; if [ -n "$cmd_id" ]; then xml_api_cli summary_report --app_id "$cmd_id" -f"$cmd_format" $cmd_scan $cmd_region $cmd_prefix $cmd_out; else xml_api_cli summary_report --app_name "$cmd_name" -f"$cmd_format" $cmd_scan $cmd_region $cmd_prefix $cmd_out; fi

tasks.label: 🧠 Review Mitigation Info
tasks.command: cmd_id='${input:appId}'; cmd_name='${input:appName}'; cmd_file='${input:file}'; cmd_sev=''; cmd_scan=''; if [ -n '${input:severity}' ]; then cmd_sev="-S${input:severity}"; fi; if [ -n '${input:scanType}' ]; then cmd_scan="-s${input:scanType}"; fi; if [ -n "$cmd_id" ]; then xml_api_cli review_mitigation --app_id "$cmd_id" $cmd_sev $cmd_scan; elif [ -n "$cmd_name" ]; then xml_api_cli review_mitigation --app_name "$cmd_name" $cmd_sev $cmd_scan; elif [ -n "$cmd_file" ]; then xml_api_cli review_mitigation --file "$cmd_file" $cmd_sev; else echo 'Error: Either app_id or app_name or input_file must be provided.'; exit 1; fi
